svg.title: How the shared state changes while case-044 is repaired
svg.desc: A table. Rows are the keys of the shared state, columns are the steps. A coloured cell means that step wrote that value. The first extraction misread 4 195.00 as 195.00, validation caught the mismatch, and the second extraction fixed it.
svg.text: How the shared state changes: a real repair (synthetic case-044)
Each column is a step. A coloured cell means that step wrote the value. Empty cells are carried over unchanged.
